subject: Thank you for the unexpected win
text: Thanks for jumping in when the client feedback landed earlier than expected. Your note on the revised timeline gave me a clear path, and because you flagged the formatting issue early, the client approved the draft without asking for another round. I would have spent the afternoon reworking the cover page and searching for the missing captions, but your quick fix changed the whole mood of the call. I also appreciate how you kept the shared folder current while I was on the phone; that saved us from sending the wrong version again. Going forward, I will keep my status updates shorter and send the file checklist before the review, so you do not have to piece things together. If any other client deliverables need a same-day polish, tell me the time and scope, and I will block the morning for it. This unexpectedly good outcome gives us a useful margin for the next sprint, so let us use it carefully, keep the revisions contained, and finish the remaining assets without turning them into last-minute scrambles. I will confirm the final export by five today and mark it complete together then. Thanks,
